'''Ants''' are a type of unremarkable [[above ground]] [[vermin]] found in large numbers in any area that isn't freezing. The color of their wild colonies reflects the material underneath it.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] ants for their ''propensity to dig''.

[[Image:Vermin-Ant.jpg‎|thumb|center|Admired for its ''propensity to dig''.]]

==Bugs==
